field_descriptions.estimated_cost: The estimated cost of the supply or supplies consumed when performing instructions.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.perform_time: The length of time it takes to perform instructions or a direction (not including time to prepare the supplies), in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).
field_descriptions.prep_time: The length of time it takes to prepare the items to be used in instructions or a direction, in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).
field_descriptions.step: A single step item (as HowToStep, text, document, video, etc.) or a HowToSection.
field_descriptions.steps: A single step item (as HowToStep, text, document, video, etc.) or a HowToSection (originally misnamed 'steps'; 'step' is preferred).
field_descriptions.supply: A sub-property of instrument. A supply consumed when performing instructions or a direction.
field_descriptions.tool: A sub property of instrument. An object used (but not consumed) when performing instructions or a direction.
field_descriptions.total_time: The total time required to perform instructions or a direction (including time to prepare the supplies), in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).
field_descriptions.yield: The quantity that results by performing instructions. For example, a paper airplane, 10 personalized candles.
